title: Food Corporation of India v. M/s Kamdhenu Cattle Feed Industries

content.caseIdentity: Food Corporation of India v. M/s Kamdhenu Cattle Feed Industries, (1993) 1 SCC 71
content.facts: A highest tenderer challenged non-acceptance of its bid and invoked legitimate expectation.
questionsBeforeCourt: Does legitimate expectation require arbitrary acceptance of a tender?
content.ratioDecidendi: Public authorities must act fairly and non-arbitrarily, but legitimate expectation does not confer an automatic right to acceptance of a commercial bid.
content.holding: The Court rejected an absolute entitlement while requiring fair dealing.
content.relevance: Use for fairness, tender decisions and the limits of legitimate expectation.
